animals.title: Why the shark never changed
animals.subtitle: 450 million years of the same design
animals.yt_title: The shark is older than trees 🦈 #shorts
animals.intro: Sharks are older than trees. And they barely changed. Here is why.
animals.outro: Older than trees. Older than Saturn's rings. Comment which one shocked you.

shots.name: Cladoselache
shots.label: 380 million years ago
shots.line: First true shark. No scales on the skin yet.
shots.line_voice: Cladoselache. The first true shark. Fast, with a torpedo body and almost no scales.
shots.prompt: Cladoselache, a primitive Devonian shark with a torpedo body and wide fins, swimming in a dark ancient sea with volcanic light

shots.name: Stethacanthus
shots.label: 360 million years ago
shots.line: An anvil-shaped fin covered in teeth on its back
shots.line_voice: Stethacanthus. It grew an anvil on its back, covered in teeth. Nobody knows why.
shots.prompt: Stethacanthus, a prehistoric shark with a strange flat anvil-shaped dorsal fin covered in tooth-like spikes, gliding over a reef

shots.name: Helicoprion
shots.label: 290 million years ago
shots.line: A buzz-saw of teeth in the lower jaw
shots.line_voice: Helicoprion. A spiral of teeth like a buzz saw in its lower jaw.
shots.prompt: Helicoprion, a prehistoric shark with a spiral buzz-saw tooth whorl in its lower jaw, hunting squid in a deep blue Permian sea

shots.name: Hybodus
shots.label: 200 million years ago
shots.line: Survived the extinction that emptied the seas
shots.line_voice: Hybodus. It survived the extinction that wiped out most of life in the sea.
shots.prompt: Hybodus, a robust prehistoric shark with two dorsal fin spines and a blunt head, in a shallow sunlit Jurassic lagoon

shots.name: Megalodon
shots.label: 20 million years ago
shots.line: Eighteen meters. The biggest shark ever.
shots.line_voice: Megalodon. Eighteen meters long. The largest shark that ever lived.
shots.prompt: Megalodon, a colossal prehistoric shark with a massive open jaw, attacking a whale from below in a dark ocean, scale of enormous size

shots.name: Great white
shots.label: today
shots.line: Same body plan for 400 million years
shots.line_voice: The great white. Same body plan, four hundred million years later.
shots.prompt: a great white shark cruising just below the surface of a sunlit ocean, seen from the side, rays of light, photoreal

bible.title: Jonah and the Whale
bible.subtitle: Jonah 1-2
bible.yt_title: He ran from God. God won. 🐋 Jonah #shorts
bible.intro: He ran from God. God won.

shots.name: The Call
shots.label: Jonah 1:2
shots.line: Go to Nineveh. Jonah went the other way.
shots.line_voice: God said: go to Nineveh. Jonah bought a ticket in the opposite direction.
shots.prompt: a bearded man in ancient robes hurrying along a busy harbor pier toward a wooden ship at dusk, looking back over his shoulder, biblical epic

shots.name: The Storm
shots.label: Jonah 1:4
shots.line: A storm only one man on board understood.
shots.line_voice: Then a storm hit. And only one man on board knew why.
shots.prompt: an ancient wooden sailing ship in a violent storm at night, huge waves, lightning, sailors clinging to ropes, dramatic biblical epic

shots.name: Overboard
shots.label: Jonah 1:15
shots.line: They threw him into the sea. The sea went calm.
shots.line_voice: They threw him overboard. And the sea went instantly calm.
shots.prompt: a man falling into a dark stormy sea from the side of an ancient ship, seen from underwater looking up, lightning above the surface, biblical epic

shots.name: Three Days
shots.label: Jonah 1:17
shots.line: Three days inside the great fish.
shots.line_voice: A great fish swallowed him. Three days and three nights in the dark.
shots.prompt: an enormous whale rising from the deep ocean with its mouth open, a tiny man silhouetted against the light inside, cinematic biblical epic

shots.name: The Shore
shots.label: Jonah 2:10
shots.line: Spat out on the shore. This time, he went.
shots.line_voice: On the third day, the fish spat him out onto dry land. This time, Jonah went.
shots.prompt: a soaked bearded man in a torn ancient linen robe kneeling on a sunrise beach, hands raised in prayer, a giant whale tail splashing far offshore, golden light, biblical epic

animals.title: How the horse evolved
animals.subtitle: From fox-sized to racehorse
animals.yt_title: The horse used to be the size of a fox 🐎 #shorts
animals.intro: Fifty-five million years ago, the horse was the size of a fox. Watch it grow.
animals.outro: Five toes to one hoof. Comment your favorite.

shots.name: Eohippus
shots.label: 55 million years ago
shots.line: Fox-sized, four toes in front, hid in forests
shots.line_voice: Eohippus. Fox-sized, four toes on each front foot, hiding in dense forests.
shots.prompt: Eohippus, a tiny fox-sized prehistoric horse with four-toed feet and a short face, standing in a lush Eocene forest with dappled light

shots.name: Mesohippus
shots.label: 37 million years ago
shots.line: Three toes, longer legs, bigger brain
shots.line_voice: Mesohippus. Three toes, longer legs, and a bigger brain.
shots.prompt: Mesohippus, a small three-toed prehistoric horse the size of a large dog, walking at the edge of an ancient woodland, morning light

shots.name: Merychippus
shots.label: 17 million years ago
shots.line: Forests turn to grass. It learns to run.
shots.line_voice: Merychippus. The forests turn to grassland. The horse learns to run.
shots.prompt: Merychippus, a pony-sized prehistoric horse with three toes but running on the middle one, galloping across open Miocene grassland

shots.name: Pliohippus
shots.label: 12 million years ago
shots.line: The first single hoof
shots.line_voice: Pliohippus. The side toes vanish. The first true single hoof.
shots.prompt: Pliohippus, a prehistoric horse with a single hoof on each leg, standing on a dry savanna under a wide sky, photoreal

shots.name: Equus
shots.label: today
shots.line: Built for speed: one toe, long legs, big lungs
shots.line_voice: Equus. The modern horse. One toe, long legs, built for speed.
shots.prompt: a powerful modern horse galloping at full speed across a golden field at sunset, mane flying, dust, photoreal

bible.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
bible.subtitle: Daniel 6
bible.yt_title: Thrown to the lions. They did not touch him. 🦁 Daniel #shorts
bible.intro: They threw him to the lions. The lions did not touch him.

shots.name: The Law
shots.label: Daniel 6:7
shots.line: Pray to anyone but the king, and you die.
shots.line_voice: A new law in Babylon: pray to anyone but the king, and you die.
shots.prompt: a Persian king on a golden throne in a vast Babylonian hall, advisors bowing, torchlight on stone columns, biblical epic

shots.name: Daniel Prays
shots.label: Daniel 6:10
shots.line: He prayed anyway. By the open window.
shots.line_voice: Daniel prayed anyway. Three times a day, by the open window, where everyone could see.
shots.prompt: an old man with a white beard kneeling in prayer by an open arched window in an ancient stone room, warm light, city of Babylon outside, biblical epic

shots.name: The Den
shots.label: Daniel 6:16
shots.line: Lowered into the pit. A stone over the mouth.
shots.line_voice: They lowered him into the den and sealed it with a stone.
shots.prompt: an old man being lowered by ropes into a dark stone pit, torches above, a huge round stone ready to seal the opening, biblical epic

shots.name: The Night
shots.label: Daniel 6:22
shots.line: Lions all around him. Not one moved.
shots.line_voice: Lions all around him in the dark. Not one of them moved.
shots.prompt: an old man sitting calmly in a dark stone den surrounded by several large lions lying peacefully, a single shaft of moonlight from above, biblical epic

shots.name: Morning
shots.label: Daniel 6:23
shots.line: Not a scratch on him.
shots.line_voice: At dawn the king ran to the den. Daniel walked out without a scratch.
shots.prompt: an old man walking up out of a stone pit into golden morning light, a king in royal robes reaching out to him in awe, biblical epic
